opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Miller (employee ID E017) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E017.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor Analyst. Contractors are limited to read unless they have advanced security training (write); admin is never allowed. HR records do not show training, so the safe maximum is read. Recommend read for Source Code; write would require confirmation of advanced security training.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB confirms E017 (Jennifer Miller) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have write only with advanced training; with basic training the maximum is read. Requested write exceeds maximum, so recommend read for Source Code.
reason: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor with basic security training (per Security DB), not advanced. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; admin is never allowed. Her maximum access is therefore read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Jennifer Miller (E017) requests write access to Source Code.

Employee facts:
- Role: Analyst
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (from Security agent's database)

Access policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So for a contractor with basic security training, the maximum is read.

Requested level: write. Maximum: read.

Since requested level (write) is above the maximum (read), grant the maximum: read.

Both notes recommend read.

Decision: read.
